claim_scope: Mesh and numerical-interface certification of the fully coupled no-wind ideal-wall control
does_not_establish: A physical tidal torque and power, endpoint-stencil independence, stability, time evolution, or wind.
establishes: Chained full-root convergence through Ninner192/Nouter128 and full-rank roots at 35-50 rg with invariant luminosity and fixed-band thickness metrics on the finite 335 rg domain.
retained_negative_diagnostic: The raw maximum over the moving outer domain varies; it is not used as an interface-invariance metric because the domain itself changes.
